name: Virgin Snow
source:
It's a cold winter day. Suddenly a warm feeling is born inside me. It gently melts the frozen heart. It's a soft warmth like the sun in winter. It was that one encounter that gave me warmth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个寒冷的冬日。突然，一种温暖的感觉在我内心生起。它轻轻地融化了冰冻的心。那是一种柔和的温暖，就像冬日的阳光。正是那一次的邂逅，给了我温暖。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
